linear_regression.name: Linear Regression
linear_regression.desc: Baseline linear model; models bicycle demand as a linear combination of environmental and temporal attributes.

ridge_regression.name: Ridge Regression
ridge_regression.desc: L2-regularized linear model; prevents multicollinearity among temporal indicators and shrinkage of weights.

lasso_regression.name: Lasso Regression
lasso_regression.desc: L1-regularized linear model; produces sparse feature weights by setting non-critical coefficients to zero.

elasticnet_regression.name: ElasticNet Regression
elasticnet_regression.desc: Blended L1 and L2 regularization; balances feature sparsity with stability among correlated temporal features.

polynomial_regression.name: Polynomial Regression
polynomial_regression.desc: Degree-2 polynomial expansion on numerical variables; captures nonlinear interactions (e.g. temp x humidity).

decision_tree.name: Decision Tree Regressor
decision_tree.desc: Non-parametric tree partitioner; captures abrupt threshold shifts in hourly rental patterns.

random_forest.name: Random Forest Regressor
random_forest.desc: Ensemble of decorrelated decision trees; top-performing model capturing multi-way feature interactions.

gradient_boosting.name: Gradient Boosting Regressor
gradient_boosting.desc: Sequential boosting model; fits additive regression trees to residual errors of previous iterations.

svr.name: Support Vector Regressor (SVR)
svr.desc: Kernelized margin-based regressor with RBF kernel; projects scaled features into infinite-dimensional Hilbert space.

knn_regressor.name: K-Nearest Neighbors Regressor
knn_regressor.desc: Instance-based local regressor; estimates rental demand by distance-weighted averaging of similar historical hours.
